summary: Comprehensive testing of new GGS features: Real-time Chat System, KYC Verification, and Admin Moderation tools. All 29 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend testing confirms all features working: Chat with profanity filter, typing indicators, read status, image sharing; KYC submission with document type selection; Admin dashboard with KYC Verify, Reports, and Chat Monitor tabs.

Admin Dashboard - Reports show View Listing, Mark Resolved, Dismiss buttons

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization issue in /messages and /conversations endpoints - was causing 500 errors
Fixed /reports endpoint to return report ID in response
Profanity filter correctly blocks words: abuse, scam, fraud, cheat, fake, stupid, idiot, fool, hate, kill, die, threat, violence, racist, sexist
KYC document numbers are properly masked (****XXXX format)
seed_data_creation: Created test KYC submissions, flagged messages, and reports during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features verified: 1) Real-time Chat with WebSocket, profanity filter (BLOCKED_WORDS list), typing indicators, read status checkmarks, image sharing, safety notice in header. 2) KYC system with document upload (Aadhaar/PAN/DL/VoterID), masked number storage, admin approval/rejection, privacy disclaimer. 3) Admin dashboard has new tabs: KYC Verify (with privacy notice), Reports (reported ads), Chat Monitor (flagged messages with original/filtered text). Fixed MongoDB _id serialization issues in messages and conversations endpoints.
